# CANDIDATE: VWAP_RIBBON_PULLBACK_LONG

**Filed:** 2026-07-22  
**Filer:** chef-nemotron (free-tier autonomous R&D)  
**Type:** new_trigger  
**Status:** DRAFT (NEEDS-RATIFICATION per Rule 9)

## Hypothesis

Price pulling back to VWAP then finding support at a bullish EMA ribbon offers a high‑probability long entry in moderate volatility. The setup combines mean-reversion to VWAP with trend-following confirmation via EMA ribbon alignment and consecutive bullish closes, filtering out noisy pullbacks.

## Mechanism

Entry: Price pulls back to within 0.1% of VWAP (|close - VWAP|/VWAP <= 0.001) and then closes above VWAP on two consecutive bullish candles (close > open) while the EMA ribbon is bullish (9EMA > 21EMA > 50EMA). Entry occurs at the open of the bar following the second bullish close. Exit: Initial stop at the low of the pullback bar (the bar that first touched VWAP within 0.1%), primary target at 1.5R (risk = entry - stop), optional runner trailed at 15% above the highest high after entry. Regime filters: VIX between 12‑18, time 09:45‑11:30 EST, price above 200EMA.

3. **Out-of-sample:** NEEDS-OOS  
4. **Real-fills:** NEEDS-REAL-FILLS  
5. **Failure modes:**  
   - False pullback: price touches VWAP within 0.1% but breaks below on next bar  
   - Regime mismatch: VIX <12 (low volatility, insufficient follow-through) or VIX>18 (high volatility, whipsaws)  
   - EMA ribbon misalignment: 9EMA ≤ 21EMA or 21EMA ≤ 50EMA during entry condition  
   - Insufficient bullish confirmation: less than two consecutive bullish closes above VWAP  
   - Stop loss hit: price breaks below pullback bar low before target  
   - Time decay: entry after 11:30 EST misses morning momentum window  
6. **Concentration:** unknown -- requires Stage-1 backtest
